title: Bhai Nand Lal and the Guru Mother’s Letter to Banda

blocks.text: The last Banda episode begins with the court looking for persuasion where open force has failed. Bhai Nand Lal at court is asked to approach the Guru Mother on the argument that Banda avenged the Sahibzadas and punished the hill chiefs, so the time has come to summon Banda back into a more regular order.

The appeal is cautious rather than affectionate. Nand Lal asks for a letter under the Guru’s seal so that Banda may be called in with authority instead of being left to answer only the emperor’s pressure.

The Guru Mother agrees reluctantly and sends that order onward. This page is therefore the diplomatic hinge in which the letter under the Guru’s seal becomes the chosen instrument for testing Banda’s obedience.
